title: unet TunnelConfig
description: Local JSON config for the embedded AmneziaWG netstack core (FR-003, FR-008). Authoritative schema for data-model.md §1. Strict loader-side validation (netip/net.SplitHostPort) is additionally enforced by ConfigLoader (T1) per F15.

hostPort.description: host:port with port 1-65535; IPv6 literals must be bracketed. Loader re-validates with net.SplitHostPort (F15).

awgHeaderValue.description: AWG H1-H4 message-header spec: single uint32 value or 'min-max' range (device/magic-header.go). Values MUST be pairwise distinct across h1..h4 and MUST NOT collide with WireGuard message types 1-4 (loader-side check, F4).

cidr.description: IP CIDR prefix, loader-side validated with netip.ParsePrefix (F15).

allOf.comment: jmin <= jmax enforced loader-side (cross-field comparison); schema narrows jmin<=65535 and jmax>=1 as hints.

schema_version.description: Config schema version (F11). Loader refuses unknown future versions with an actionable upgrade error; unknown top-level fields are a load error (additionalProperties: false).

local_addresses.description: THIS CLIENT's tunnel-side IP addresses assigned to the netstack NIC (CreateNetTUN(localAddresses, dnsServers, mtu); F1). Must intersect peer.allowed_ips configured server-side, e.g. ['10.66.0.2/32'] with the hub's [Peer] AllowedIPs=10.66.0.2/32.

private_key.description: Client WG private key (base64). Auto-generated on first run if absent (FR-008). MAY be omitted here and supplied via UNET_PRIVATE_KEY. PLAINTEXT-AT-REST when present (FR-008.001); file MUST be 0600/owner-only (FR-008.002/.003).

public_key.description: Client WG public key (base64). Sole tunnel identity to the gateway (FR-006).

endpoint.description: Exit endpoint host:port; host MAY be a DNS name and is re-resolved on roaming (FR-007.002).

persistent_keepalive.description: Seconds; 0 disables (not recommended — liveness per FR-007.005(i) expects keepalives).

obfuscation.description: AmneziaWG DPI-evasion parameters (FR-003). Aligned with repos/unet AWG 1.5 UAPI (device/uapi.go): jc/jmin/jmax MUST be positive when present (UAPI rejects <=0 — omit the key instead of sending 0); s3/s4/i1..i5 supported and optional; H values may be uint32 or 'min-max' range strings. S1/S2 are handshake paddings, S3 cookie padding, S4 TRANSPORT padding (dominates data-path MTU budget, FR-010/R5).

jc.description: Junk packet count. Omit entirely to disable (AWG treats absent as 0; UAPI rejects 0, F4).

jmax.description: Keep below system MTU to avoid IP fragmentation of junk packets.

s4.description: Transport-message padding — counts against per-packet MTU budget (FR-010).

i1.description: Custom signature packet spec (tag sequence <b>/<r>/<rd>/<rc>/<t>); client-side only.

resolution_mode.description: v1 ships tunnel_dns ONLY (F2): names resolve via dns[] servers reachable inside the tunnel through gVisor LookupContextHost; there is no exit-side hostname-forwarding protocol over the raw L3 tunnel. The 'remote' mode is deferred to 003-ecosystem-integration (requires an exit-side SOCKS/resolver daemon contract).

dns.description: Tunnel-side resolver IP(s) reachable inside the tunnel (FR-009). Required (resolution_mode is const tunnel_dns). e.g. the gateway tailnet IP running dnsmasq (10.66.0.1) per ops/option0-baseline.

mtu.description: Tunnel MTU (FR-010). Default computed as path_mtu - outer(20 IP + 8 UDP) - WG data header(32) - S4 padding. gVisor derives TCP MSS from this NIC MTU (no SYN clamping exists in netstack). 1420 is the safe default on 1500-byte paths; >1420 risks outer UDP fragmentation (F9).

listen.description: Loopback host:port, Unix socket (unix:///path) or abstract (@name) on platforms supporting it; loader-side validated (FR-004, F15).

password.description: Secret-bearing. If present, config file MUST be owner-only; prefer password_env on shared hosts. REQUIRED non-empty when auth_enabled=true (F6).

password_env.description: Environment variable name containing the proxy password.

shared_host.description: If true, refuse to start unauthenticated (FR-004 multi-user caveat).

address.description: Tunnel-internal gateway yamux listener host:port (gateway binds the TAILNET address, e.g. 10.66.0.1:7443 — NOT public loopback; interfaces.md §4.2, F3).

capability_token.description: Optional per-tunnel token, first yamux control frame (FR-006.002). Secret-bearing; prefer capability_token_env.

capability_token_env.description: Environment variable name containing the gateway capability token.

allow_list.description: Default-deny reverse-forward authorization (FR-006.001) — CLIENT-side defense-in-depth; the gateway keeps its own authoritative (public_host, public_port, proto) → public_key table (interfaces.md §4.3, F3). Empty/absent => no reverse-forward permitted.

public_host.description: Optional hostname the gateway should match for this mapping (informational; authority is the gateway table).

proto.description: Stream proto this mapping applies to (F3).

reconnect.description: Backoff, liveness and terminal-failure knobs (FR-007). ONE terminal policy branch must hold (oneOf — F7).

retry_forever.description: Explicit infinite-retry opt-in. Keeps health degraded and emits periodic warnings. Mutually exclusive with finite limits (F7).
